qwiic_ultrasonic_init.tooltip: Initialize SparkFun Qwiic Ultrasonic distance sensor (I2C default address 0x2F)

qwiic_ultrasonic_read.tooltip: Trigger a measurement and read the last available distance in mm. Returns -1 on an I²C error.

qwiic_ultrasonic_j2_pulse.message0: TCT40 J2 echo width (µs) TRIG %1 ECHO %2
qwiic_ultrasonic_j2_pulse.tooltip: Choose two separate 3.3 V pins. Sends a 50 µs trigger and measures the low echo pulse. Returns 0 on a 40 ms timeout.
